Independently recomputed from scratch via inputs/artifacts/mn.py: row orthogonality 5/5 (n=8..12), column orthogonality, sum dim^2=n!, all dims match hook formula, standard character (n-1,1) matches m1-1, sign row correct, conjugate duality chi^{lam'}=sgn*chi^{lam} spot-checked, square-type map C->C^2 verified against explicit permutation squaring for every class n=8..12, trivial-lambda m-column equals Kronecker delta. Full rho(4) table recomputed from fresh tables: 42/42 rows match rho4_split.json with exact integrality/parity/nonnegativity; dim sums 295296=768*769/2 and 294528=768*767/2; censuses g>0 42/42, s>0 42/42, a>0 38/42 with zeros exactly {[10],[9,1],[8,2],[1^10]}, self-pair g=117/s=59/a=58. Exhaustive (lam,nu) rescan from scratch for n=8..12 reproduces max gaps 6,8,15,24,43 with exact maximizer sets (unique n=8,12; tied x2 n=9,10,11) and all top-five tables. originality.rationale: Nearest prior Bessenrodt-Bowman arXiv:2202.03066 (v3, checked abstract plus full HTML Secs 1-10) declares symmetric/alternating results scarce and proves only family theorems: hooks (Sec.4), small depth (Sec.5), sign/neighbour (Sec.6), 2-part [k,k]/[k+1,k]/[k+1,k-1] (Sec.7/Thm B), homogeneous/inhomogeneous (Thm A/Sec.8), multiplicity-free (Thms 9.3-9.4), 2-modular links (Sec.3/Thm D), refined-Saxl Conjecture C and HSTZ refinement (Sec.10). It states Conjecture C (S^2[rho_k] contains all irreps except sign when k=2 mod 4) as conjecture with only aggregated hook-parity sums for rho_k, not a window-complete (s_nu,a_nu) table for rho(4) at n=10 across all 42 nu, and no per-n maximal-gap |s-a| census for n=8-12. rho(4)=(4,3,2,1) is depth 6, not a hook/small-depth/2-part case, so family theorems do not imply the table. Nearby priors 1304.0738 (hooks/two-row unsplit positivity), 1310.8362 (unsplit polynomial method), 1903.07717 (2-separated modular unsplit positivity) are unsplit or family-specific and do not compute square-class symmetrization sums or gap extremals. Internal S12 vanishing census / S8 unsplit maximum concern unsplit g, a different object and route. No overlapping exact splitting table with gap witnesses was found; claim is substantively new finite census/benchmark, not established by timestamp or failed search.

value.rationale: Result is independently worth finding later as a citable refined-Saxl benchmark, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration. (a) Recognized program: tests BB Conjecture C at its first nontrivial triangular case k=4 (n=10, k=0 mod 4 predicts full S^2 positivity) with exact 42/42 symmetric positivity certificate, plus unsplit Saxl containment 42/42. (b) New refinement beyond libraries: standard libraries return unsplit g, not square-class-separated (s,a) pairs with class-sum certificates or gap-extremality proofs. (c) Extremal witnesses with disclosure: per-n maximal |s-a| over all p(n)^2 ordered pairs with exhaustive maximality certificates, tie counts, and top-five tables; staircase connection (n=10 maximizers inside rho(4) square; n=11,12 witnesses staircase-adjacent) is reported. (d) Reusable pipeline: from-scratch Murnaghan-Nakayama plus symmetrization sums with orthogonality/dimsum/dimension-sum identities and independent replay verifier; m-column is certified input to BB Sec.3/Thm D 2-modular relations (spot-confirmed: m_{rho4}(lam)=0 for all lam!=rho4 at n=10) and hook sub-table for BB Sec.4/6 calibration. Natural scope n=8-12 brackets triangular n=10 where character methods are exact.
